lines.text: Two hundred sensors. Four video feeds. One wind field.
Encirra fuses them into a single CBRN picture.
A concept command centre for Barakah, built on synthetic data.
A gamma trend climbs in Unit 3.
Encirra correlates the sources, sends the ground robot, and re-tasks the drone.
Then a person validates. Recommendations are advisory. Nothing acts on its own.
